# Advanced Supply Chain Group Ltd

Advanced Supply Chain Group Ltd is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. ASCG is an established end-to-end supply chain and advanced global logistics service provider with over 25 years of experience. Advanced Supply Chain Group Ltd employs 515 people (+3.0% YoY, +15 people) and has an annual revenue of GBP70.2M. Headquartered in Bradford, United Kingdom, with presence in Hong Kong and United Arab Emirates. Its workforce is distributed across 11 countries (including United Kingdom, Germany, United Arab Emirates, Czechia, and India).

## About

At the forefront of the UK’s technology driven logistics sector, Advanced Supply Chain Group provides intelligent, international supply chain solutions to retailers, brands and manufacturers.
Using our unique intelligent supply chain model we design innovative solutions to solve complex challenges. We unlock new opportunities for our customers, and speed up and streamline existing processes by removing complexity from the supply chain. This all adds up to reduced costs, better speed to market and fine control of getting the right thing to the right place at the right time.
Our approach has underpinned our customers’ success for 25 years, which has been recognised with a number of industry awards. Together, we’ve established Advanced Supply Chain Group as the partner of choice to many of the world’s most admired and successful brands.
